Claim 1 (Currently amended): A computing device for mapping user movements captured by a capture device external to the computing device, to input events on the computing device, the computing device comprising: a display to display an application executing on the computing device; a client sharing module to: __receive__ video data of the application from a source device; and transmit gesture data associated with the application, the gesture data based on movements of a user captured from a capture device communicatively coupled to the receiver device; and a mapping module to: map the gesture data into an input event on the computing device; and provide data simulating the input event to a sensor of the computing device.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The computing device of claim 1, wherein to map the gesture data into an input event on the computing device, the mapping module is to: retrieve a type of movement of the user from the gesture data; and determine the input event based on the type of movement, the input event being selected from a group consisting of a touch input event, a rotate input event, and other input events.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The computing device of claim 2, wherein when the type of movement of the user is a swipe movement, the gesture data is mapped to a touch input event, and data simulating the touch input event is provided to a touch sensor of the computing device.

Claim 4 (Cancelled)

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The computing device of claim 1, wherein the client sharing module is to: establish a video channel between the computing device and a receiver device; establish an input channel between the computing device and receiver device; and wherein the video data is received over the video channel and gesture data is transmitted via the input channel.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): The computing device of claim 1, wherein to transmit video data of the application to a receiver device, the client sharing module is to: stream video displayed on the display of the computing device to the receiver device via the video channel.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The computing device of claim 1, wherein the client sharing module is to transmit updated video data to the receiver device based on the application updating in response to the input event.

Claim 8 (Original)

Claim 9 (Original)

Claim 10 (Currently amended): A method of mapping user movements captured by a capture device external to a computing device, to input events on the computing device, the method comprising: executing an application on the computing device, using at least one processor of the computing device; transmitting, from the computing device, video data of the application to a receiver device; receiving, at the computing device from the receiver device, gesture data associated with the application, the gesture data based on movements of a user captured from a capture device communicatively coupled to the receiver device; mapping the gesture data to an input event on the computing device; and providing data simulating the input event to a sensor on the computing device.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The method of claim 10, wherein mapping the gesture data into an input event on the computing device comprises: retrieving a type of movement of the user from the gesture data; and determining the input event based on the type of movement, the input event being selected from a group consisting of a touch input event, a rotate input event, and other input events.

Claim 12 (Currently amended): The method of claim 11, wherein mapping the gesture data into an input event further comprises: mapping the gesture data to a touch input event when the type of movement is a swipe movement.

Claim 13 (Currently amended): The method of claim 12, wherein providing the data simulating the input event to the sensor on the computing device comprises: providing data simulating the touch input event to a touch sensor on the computing device.

Claim 14 (Cancelled)

Claim 15 (Cancelled)

Claim 16 (Currently amended): The method of claim 10, further comprising: establishing a video channel between the computing device and a receiver device; establishing an input channel between the computing device and the receiver device; and wherein the video data is received over the video channel and gesture data is transmitted via the input channel.

Claim 17 (Currently amended): The method of claim 16, wherein transmitting video data of the application to a receiver device comprises: streaming video displayed on a display of the computing device to the receiver device via the video channel.

Claim 18 (Original)

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The method of claim 10, further comprising: transmitting updated video data to the receiver device based on the application updating in response to the input event.
